inputs.topic: WP13 drizzle-orm upgrade correction (T17 batch 2 follow-up, PR #510)
inputs.trigger: CI integration-db lane FAIL + fresh read-only Claude review FAIL on commit 7df94569
commands: npx vitest run (apps/api, full suite, x2)

raw.narrative: PR #510's original receipt (archive/receipts/2026-09-04-audit-wp13-drizzle-upgrade.json, deleted in this batch, never reached main) claimed 'no source change needed' and that 'existing string/code checks against nested driver errors still work'. Both were wrong. CI's integration-db lane FAILED on the original commit (7df94569) and a fresh read-only Claude review returned FAIL. Root cause: since drizzle-orm 0.44.0, db.execute/tx.execute/the query builder/transactions all rethrow driver errors wrapped in DrizzleQueryError (node_modules/drizzle-orm/errors.js) -- message 'Failed query: ...\nparams: ...', fields query/params/cause, NO .code. The real Postgres error (SQLSTATE code, message) is only reachable at .cause. Three call sites read a caught DB error's .code/.message directly and broke: (1) apps/api/src/lib/account-service.ts isUniqueViolation(err) read err.code directly -- a duplicate-email race escaped as an unhandled 500 instead of EmailAlreadyRegisteredError -> 409, reproduced in the CI log on POST /v1/auth/register. (2) apps/api/src/app.ts classifyError(err) read err.code and the bind-encoder TypeError shape directly -- every DB failure logged error_class:'unknown' with no pg_code, undoing the PR-43 observability fix; src/app.classify-error.test.ts never fed it a wrapped error so it stayed green while the classifier had silently stopped working. (3) apps/api/src/lib/receipt/execution-receipt.integration.test.ts (8 assertions) plus three sibling *.integration.test.ts files -- partial-quarantine.integration.test.ts (1), receipt-chain-junction.integration.test.ts (1), receipt-invariants.integration.test.ts (16) -- asserted .rejects.toThrow(/trigger-or-constraint-text/) against the wrapper's generic message, which no longer contains that text (26 assertions total across 4 files). A grep sweep for every other reader of a caught DB error's .code/.message/.constraint/.detail found one more site, not yet reproduced in prod but the same class of bug: apps/api/src/lib/startup-db-retry.ts isTransientDbConnectError reads err.code to decide whether a startup DB-connectivity failure is transient; runStartupMigrations()/validateSchema() call db.execute() internally, so a connection failure surfacing through a query attempt is wrapped the same way. Fixed proactively.

fix.new_module: apps/api/src/lib/db-error.ts -- the only place that knows the wrapper's shape (unwrapDbError, pgErrorCode, dbErrorMessage, wasWrapped). Identification is by `instanceof DrizzleQueryError` (imported from drizzle-orm/errors), with a SQLSTATE-bearing-cause heuristic as a fallback -- NOT `err.name === 'DrizzleQueryError'` as the follow-up brief originally specified: verified against the installed 0.45.2 build that DrizzleQueryError does not set `this.name` at all (it inherits the bare 'Error' name from its Error superclass), so that check would never match. This is a documented deviation from the brief's exact wording, not from its intent.
fix.account_service_ts: isUniqueViolation now reads pgErrorCode(err) instead of err.code directly.
fix.app_ts: classifyError unwraps first, then runs every existing branch against the unwrapped error; adds wrapped:true to the result only when unwrapping actually happened, so the exact prior output shape is preserved for every already-unwrapped input (all 7 pre-existing classifyError tests pass unchanged).
fix.startup_db_retry_ts: isTransientDbConnectError unwraps first before reading .code/.message/AggregateError shape.
fix.new_test_helper: apps/api/src/test-support/db-errors.ts (expectDbRejection) -- awaits the rejection, unwraps with dbErrorMessage, asserts the regex against the unwrapped message, falls back to the raw message so the same assertion also passes against an unwrapped driver error. All 26 affected integration-test assertions converted to it across 4 files.

sites_judged_unaffected: apps/api/src/jobs/quality-floor.integration.test.ts -- uses a raw postgres() tagged-template client directly (import postgres from "postgres"), never drizzle's db.execute/query builder; its two rejects.toThrow assertions never pass through DrizzleQueryError.

apps/api/src/lib/receipt/receipt-invariants.integration.test.ts's 'a mis-addressed snapshot is refused on read' test -- readManifestSnapshot's rejection is a JS-level thrown Error from manifest-snapshot.ts's own validation logic, not a DB-raised error; left as plain .rejects.toThrow(/mis-addressed/).
apps/api/src/lib/wallet-service.integration.test.ts's 'must run inside a transaction' assertion -- a JS-level thrown Error from wallet-service.ts's own transaction guard, not a DB-raised error.

apps/api/src/lib/startup-migrations.ts's 4 err.message log lines (grepped: lines inside runMigration0095_walletReservations, runMigration0098_perCustomerIdempotency, runMigration0099_noHalfQuarantine, runMigration0101_capabilityInvocations) -- all 4 are inside ledgered migration-block functions; left untouched per the append-only ledger rule (npm run migrations:check hashes each block). Diagnostic-only degradation (no control-flow effect) -- the module already treats its own non-ledgered logging the same way.

test_evidence_fail_first.method: git show HEAD:<path> > <path> to swap in the pre-fix file, run the new test (recorded failing), restore the fix from a scratchpad backup copy taken before the swap -- never git stash (repo-wide, shared across worktrees) and never git checkout <branch> -- <path> (on an uncommitted-fix worktree this silently restores the branch tip, i.e. the pre-fix version, discarding the fix -- hit once in this session on account-service.ts and recovered by re-applying the edit from the Read tool's captured content).
test_evidence_fail_first.db_error_test_ts: 13 new tests. db-error.ts is a brand-new module (no pre-fix version exists to swap in), so fail-first evidence here is the module's own correctness demonstrated by the 13 tests passing; the meaningful fail-first evidence is on the three call-site files below.
test_evidence_fail_first.account_service_test_ts: 3 new tests. Against the swapped-in pre-fix account-service.ts: 'a wrapped 23505 (unique violation) rejects with EmailAlreadyRegisteredError' FAILS -- AssertionError: expected Error: Failed query: insert into users ... to be an instance of EmailAlreadyRegisteredError. The other 2 tests (wrapped 23503 rethrows; unwrapped 23505 still works) pass either way, as expected -- they are not regression-discriminating for THIS bug, only the wrapped-23505 case is. After restoring the fix, all 3 pass.
test_evidence_fail_first.app_classify_error_test_ts: 3 new tests. Against the swapped-in pre-fix app.ts: both 'classifies a WRAPPED unique violation' and 'classifies a WRAPPED bind-encoder TypeError' FAIL -- received {error_class:'unknown'} instead of {error_class:'db_unique_violation', pg_code:'23505', wrapped:true} / {error_class:'db_bind_encoder', wrapped:true}. The 'does not set wrapped when never wrapped' test passes either way (not discriminating). After restoring the fix, all 3 pass, plus all 7 pre-existing tests still pass unchanged.
test_evidence_fail_first.startup_db_retry_test_ts: 2 new tests. Against the swapped-in pre-fix startup-db-retry.ts: 'still matches a WRAPPED CONNECT_TIMEOUT' FAILS -- AssertionError: expected false to be true. 'still rejects a WRAPPED real SQL error' passes either way (not discriminating -- the pre-fix code's message-substring fallback happens to also return false for this input). After restoring the fix, both pass, plus all 15 pre-existing tests still pass unchanged.
